title: ssr_wfs~
description: `ssr_wfs~` appears to perform Wave Field Synthesis spatialization, routing audio to a 19-channel `dac~`. The example creates it with `2`, the loudspeaker-layout file `circle.asd`, and the prefilter file `wfs_prefilter_120_1500_44100.wav`, while `ssr_messages` appears to provide control messages.
